document.abstract: This document describes the Zero Configuration (ZeroConf) and service discovery mechanisms defined for the Media Device Control (MDC) [SMPTE ST 2071] suite of standards. Defining how MDC compliant devices utilize existing network services, or in the absence of such services, use existing Zero Configuration (ZeroConf) techniques and standards to automatically construct a fully functional system.
